message.content: It started with pain between my shoulder blades about two days ago, and it didn't spread anywhere. Then my legs got weaker until I couldn't stand, and I lost control of my bowels and bladder. I had no fall, injury, or heavy lifting. No fever. I don't have any long-term illnesses and I don't take blood thinners or other medicines. I wasn't asked about injected drugs in my history, so I don't know about that.
